challenges.title: MyZubster comic story concept
challenges.objective: Create an original short comic concept set in the MyZubster universe, including premise, audience, main conflict and a 6-10 beat story outline.
acceptance: Original concept with clear beginning, middle and end
Suitable for a short illustrated comic
MyZubster is meaningfully integrated into the story
No unauthorized third-party characters or protected franchise material
Any material AI assistance is disclosed

challenges.title: Character design sheet
challenges.objective: Create a production-ready character sheet for an original MyZubster comic character with consistent front/side/three-quarter views and expression references.
acceptance: At least three consistent character views
At least four readable expressions
Visual design is original and reproducible across comic panels
Web-ready export and source/editable file are provided when applicable
Rights and AI-assistance disclosures are complete

challenges.title: Storyboard and page layout
challenges.objective: Turn an approved MyZubster comic script or concept into a readable storyboard for 4-6 comic pages, showing panel flow, dialogue placement and key visual beats.
acceptance: 4-6 pages of clear sequential storytelling
Panel order and reading direction are unambiguous
Dialogue/caption placement is planned
Characters and environments remain visually consistent
Storyboard can be handed off to a final artist

challenges.title: Finished comic sequence
challenges.objective: Produce a polished 4-6 page MyZubster comic sequence from an approved script/storyboard, including final art and lettering.
acceptance: 4-6 finished sequential pages
Readable lettering and coherent page flow
Consistent character and environment design
Publication-ready PDF or high-resolution image exports
Required rights, source-file and AI disclosures are supplied

challenges.title: Complete MyZubster short comic
challenges.objective: Create a complete original MyZubster short comic/episode suitable for public release, covering script, sequential art, lettering and final publication assets.
acceptance: Complete self-contained story with an approved scope
Professional and internally consistent sequential art
Final lettering is readable on desktop and mobile
Cover/title treatment and publication-ready export are included
All submitted materials can be legally used under the bounty license terms
Any material AI assistance is disclosed
Source/editable assets required by the issue are delivered
